include_conditions.description: Preserve intra-eojeol and inter-eojeol candidates as two separately accounted populations.
The left Hangul unit has a non-empty coda.
The right Hangul unit has zero onset and a nucleus in {ㅣ,ㅑ,ㅕ,ㅛ,ㅠ,ㅖ,ㅒ}; /i/ and /j/ environment types remain separately coded.
Do not add a left-POS filter; retain broad left contexts for later environment review.

exclude_conditions.description: Exclude right J* and E* from the frozen main-population query.
exclude_conditions.exclusion_reason: Frozen query regex ^(?!J|E); the decided 요/JX environment is recorded separately as an exploratory query candidate.

exclude_conditions.description: Exclude numeric, symbol, and other non-Hangul adjacent units from the main population.
exclude_conditions.exclusion_reason: Both unit types must equal hangul in the frozen query.

exclude_conditions.description: Exclude ㅢ because it is not in the frozen right-nucleus set.
exclude_conditions.exclusion_reason: The frozen query contains seven measured nuclei and does not contain ㅢ.

retention_rules.description: Uncertain or missing sense IDs remain as status and candidate fields; they are not exclusion conditions.
etym_unknown and conditional etym_origin values remain available and are never imputed or dropped.

confound_phenomena.relation: Inserted [n] may be followed by nasalization of the preceding coda, so surface nasal sequences cannot by themselves establish insertion.
confound_phenomena.discriminator: Researcher auditory/acoustic/TextGrid evidence in a later manual ledger; no automatic judgement in Gate 1.

confound_phenomena.relation: The proposed rule-inversion relation between n-insertion and n-deletion is disputed.
confound_phenomena.discriminator: Keep as a theoretical confound, not an occurrence filter.

confound_phenomena.relation: A candidate may also bear evidence relevant to nasalization, liquid-related alternation, or compound-boundary tensification.
confound_phenomena.discriminator: Allow shared phenomenon membership; do not force a single exclusive label in Gate 1.

confound_phenomena.relation: Sino-Korean internal structure, compound boundary, and sai-siot analyses may provide competing structural accounts.
confound_phenomena.discriminator: Preserve boundary_etym_class as routing evidence and require researcher confirmation before analysis membership.

confound_phenomena.relation: AP/IP boundaries may condition inter-eojeol realization.
confound_phenomena.discriminator: Defer to a later sidecar and read-only TextGrid/prosody review; do not classify or exclude occurrences in Gate 1.

membership_rules.description: Shared membership across NI and another phenomenon is allowed and must not silently remove a candidate from either inventory.
The four-class environment table classifies environment types, not the 941903 individual occurrences.
요/JX is a decided exploratory query candidate outside the main population and has separate accounting.

unresolved_items.description: Check CLM-0015 before freezing Sino-Korean resonant/obstruent environment claims.
Keep CLM-0008 as a non-blocking theoretical confound unless used as a decisive contract claim.
Use CLM-0026 qualitatively unless the original variation studies are checked for numeric claims.
Inter-eojeol environment class and AP/IP information remain pending until a later context/prosody Gate.
Researcher confirmation is required before creating a frozen contract version.
